column1: # Every distinct mana_cost string in Scryfall's oracle-cards bulk file of 2026-10-17 (38753 cards).
# card: cost of a single-faced card, with its cmc and colors (- for none, ? when only devoid or color-indicator cards carry it).
# face: cost of one face of a multi-faced card. faces: the card-level "A // B" text of a split or adventure card.
